chunks: And Abān narrated from Abī Maryam, from Abī ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام, who said:
The virgin who has a father is not to marry in mutʿah except with her father's permission.
ai.seo_question: Can a virgin woman enter into mutʿah without her father's permission?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling regarding mutʿah for a virgin woman whose father is living. It states that such a marriage is not contracted except with the permission of her father, indicating the role of paternal authorization in this case.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.4593 - Aban narrated from Abu Maryam, from Abu Abdillah (as):
"The virgin who has a father cannot marry in Mutah (temporary marriage) except with her father's permission."
